name: 32601 · Gainesville, FL
findings: ZIP 32601 (Gainesville) has 140 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32601 (Gainesville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
77% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
